journals.title: David Roberts Welsh Journal
journals.sourceTitle: FAMILY HISTORY, WRITINGS AND POEMS of DAVID ROBERTS, NATIVE OF LLANFROTHEN, MEIRIONETHSHIRE, WALES
journals.primaryWriter: David Roberts and later Roberts family contributors
journals.language: Primarily Welsh, with later English additions and inserted printed material
journals.description: One physically two-ended family volume containing Welsh poetry and other writings, a Welsh family-history and journal sequence, later family additions, and inserted printed material.
journals.sourceIdentityNote: This is one physical source begun by David Roberts and later continued, copied, translated, annotated, or supplemented by Roberts family contributors. The site does not attribute the entire volume to one hand.
journals.physicalStructureNote: Verified PDF structure: covers on pages 1 and 110; poetry/writings on pages 2-62; inserted/printed poetry on pages 63-66; family-history title leaf on page 67; family-history/journal sequence on pages 68-109.
journals.exportStatus: Welsh transcription, modern English translation, bilingual Word, and combined PDF exports are defined for later generation from these same page Markdown files; they are not published as complete while nearly all pages remain untranscribed.

attributionModel.historicalConstraint: David Roberts died November 4, 1858; post-death material is not attributed as newly written by him.

journalPages.pageLanguage: Welsh handwriting and English pasted label
journalPages.sourceTranscriptionLabel: Source transcription (English title label and Welsh handwriting)
journalPages.welshTranscription:
[Untranscribed: Welsh handwriting above the pasted title label.]

FAMILY HISTORY, WRITINGS AND POEMS
of
DAVID ROBERTS, NATIVE OF
LLANFROTHEN, MEIRIONETHSHIRE, WALES
He was the first
PRESIDENT OF THE FESTINIOG, WALES,
BRANCH OF THE CHURCH OF JESUS CHRIST
OF LATTER DAY SAINTS

D. R. Roberts
Ogden Utah
Chairman
Aug. 1948
journalPages.translation: [Not applicable: the transcribed pasted title label is already in English.]
journalPages.notes: Initial visual transcription of the pasted English title label. The Welsh handwriting above it remains untranscribed. The identity and role of the person signing "D. R. Roberts" have not been resolved.
journalPages.contentContext: Family-history title leaf. The pasted label identifies David Roberts and the Llanfrothen/Festiniog context; Welsh writing above the label is preserved separately from the English label.
journalPages.editor: D. R. Roberts (as written; identity unresolved)
journalPages.attributionBasis: A pasted title label is signed D. R. Roberts and dated Aug. 1948; the signer's identity is unresolved.
